culprit_citations.quoted_text: Wholesale Supplies Plus Holdings, LLC | Class A Common Units | 10/1/2021 | N/A | 3,400 | 3,400,000 | 2,974,150 | 1.0 | % | (6)

findings.detail: The source row has amortized cost 3,400,000 and fair value 2,974,150; the X08 flag indicates the extracted fair value was a tiny value, likely the adjacent 1.0 percent-of-net-assets cell.

rationale: X08 fired because the extracted holding had fair value below 5% of cost 3,400,000. The raw schedule row for Wholesale Supplies Plus Holdings shows the fair value column as 2,974,150, which is about 87.5% of cost, followed by a separate 1.0 percent-of-net-assets cell. The flag is therefore a real extraction error in the fair_value field, not an economically distressed source position.
